mentions.name: Abbox
mentions.description: Abbox helps engineers stay focused on long tasks by shielding them from interruptions caused by non-technical people submitting small requests, such as minor design tweaks, adding tracking, or fixing styles that don't match Figma.
mentions.problem: Engineers get interrupted and lose focus by small ad-hoc requests from non-technical people, like changing an h1 to h2, adding tracking to a share button, or fixing mismatched styles.
mentions.audience: Engineers who get distracted by small requests from non-technical colleagues
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Abbox trying to help engineers focus longer on tasks without being interrupted by non-technical people with small requests.
mentions.author: elchuzade
